title: The Sphinx as a dynastic monument carved on an older bedrock outcrop

tellings.quote: So, I think the Sphinx itself is a dynastic monument >> Uh-huh. that was built on an existing bedrock outcrop within the Sphinx enclosure.

plain: The Great Sphinx at Giza, Egypt, is a monument of the pharaohs' era that was carved onto a rock outcrop already standing in its enclosure, according to the researcher Jeffrey Drum. Drum offers this as his own view, without naming a source. It would mean the statue is younger than the stone it sits on, leaving room for something older at the site.
